verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI325X is a GPU accelerator: hardware plus its ROCm software stack. A story about performing bulk operations across many items is an application or data-management workflow axis, which is a category error for this kind of product. The fleet and cluster management tools in the pack (AMD SMI, the Kubernetes GPU Operator, the Spur scheduler) are adjacent infrastructure controls. None is documented as a bulk item-operations capability, so they do not make the axis apply.
